findings.issue: the negative ROUND=.TRUE. boundary claimed -HUGE-0.5 is out of range, but on a two's-complement kind -HUGE-1 is representable (the p7 example: OUT_OF_RANGE(-128.5, 0_INT8) is false without ROUND); the integer lower bound is not portable
findings.resolution: only the positive boundary: HUGE(0_k)+0.25 false and HUGE(0_k)+0.5 true under ROUND=.TRUE.

findings.issue: REAL(HUGE(0.0_small), large) false was guarded only by RANGE, but conversion can round above the small-kind boundary
findings.resolution: same-kind OUT_OF_RANGE(HUGE(0.0_k), 0.0_k) is .FALSE.; the cross-kind case is kept only for true overflow

findings.issue: reopened: DIGITS(real) >= DIGITS(integer)+1 is insufficient; with H = 2^q-1, H+0.25 needs q+2 significand bits, otherwise it is a rounding tie that may become H+0.5
reopened: the bit argument assumes H = 2^q-1, which needs the integer model radix to be 2 as well
findings.resolution: RADIX(0_k)==2 added to both boundary plans, with the reason for each guard stated
